notes: Infer (src/Infer.sol) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints 1,000,000,000 INFER exactly once to msg.sender. It has no external mint or burn function, transfer fees, administrative powers, or initialization calls. No application contracts are deployed. The pool uses the requested paired token, a 0.3% fee, and tick spacing 60. initialPrice is provenance only: floor(sqrt(initialMarketCapWei / totalSupply) * 2^96), expressed with INFER as currency0 and the paired token as currency1. The deployer derives the actual opening price from the supplied economics and total supply using the deployed currency ordering.
